description: Op-shaped job that ships new Dagster event log entries to Splunk via the HTTP Event Collector (HEC). Simpler than dagster_plus_to_siem_job: OSS event log only, single-destination.

hec_token_env.description: Env var holding the HEC token (sent as 'Authorization: Splunk <token>').
hec_token_env.label: Hec Token Env

index.description: Optional Splunk index (falls back to HEC default).
index.label: Index

verify_ssl.description: Verify TLS cert (False for self-signed dev Splunk).
verify_ssl.label: Verify Ssl

initial_lookback_hours.description: On first run, pull events from last N hours.
initial_lookback_hours.label: Initial Lookback Hours
